== Biography ==
{{Scotland Sticker}}
Anna was born about 1738 in Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, Scotland. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1075|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Allan-4046|Margaret Allan]]. On 23 December 1757 in Kilbirnie, Anna married [[Allan-8028|Hugh Allan]].<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Banns and Marriages," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), marriage of Hugh Allan and Anna Glasgow 23 Dec 1757; citing Ref No: 10 / 141, parish 596.</ref><ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Banns and Marriages," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), marriage of Hugh Allan and Anna Glasgow 23 Dec 1757; citing Ref No: 30 / 49, parish 599.</ref> They had thirteen children:
#[[Allan-8029|Margaret Allan]], baptised 27 September 1758.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Margaret Allan 27 Sep 1758, daughter of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 135, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8030|Robert Allan]], born 1 July 1760.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Robert Allan 3 Jul 1760, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 142, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8031|James Allan]], baptised 9 March 1762,<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), James Allan 9 Mar 1762, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 147, parish 599.</ref> died young.
#[[Allan-8032|Ann Allan]], baptised 10 November 1763.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Ann Allan 10 Nov 1763, daughter of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 152, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8033|Janet Allan]], born 6 August 1765.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Janet Allan 10 Aug 1765, daughter of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 157, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8034|Hugh Allan]], baptised 19 January 1768.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Hugh Allan 19 Jan 1768, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 164, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8035|John Allan]], baptised 8 January 1770.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), John Allan 8 Jan 1770, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 170, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8036|Charles Allan]], baptised 9 September 1771.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Charles Allan 9 Sep 1771, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasfurd; citing Ref No: 20 / 175, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8037|Jean Allan]], baptised 13 July 1773.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Jean Allan 13 Jul 1773, daughter of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 184, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8038|William Allan]], born 7 August 1775,<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), William Allan 7 Aug 1775, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 193, parish 599.</ref> died in childhood.
#[[Allan-8039|William Allan]], baptised 20 May 1777.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), William Allan 20 May 1777, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 201, parish 599.</ref>
#[[Allan-8040|James Allan]], baptised 4 May 1780,<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), James Allan 4 May 1780, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 219, parish 599.</ref> died in infancy.
#[[Allan-8041|James Glasgow Allan]], baptised 8 June 1781.<ref>Kilwinning Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), James Glasgow Allan 8 Jun 1781, son of Hugh Allan and Ann Glasgow; citing Ref No: 20 / 224, parish 599.</ref>
